paper.subject: astronomy
paper.title: Observational Examination (OM)
paper.caveat: The star map on which the tasks are to be performed is not part of the archived question paper; the tasks reference it.

transcription.notes: Single-page question paper for the observational round. Each task carries its points in a boxed marker on the right margin ([20], [15], [5], [5], [5]); total = 50. The star map itself is not included in the archived PDF (presumably distributed separately on the answer sheet), so no figure crops are proposed. The logo in the masthead ("10th IOAA, Bhubaneswar India") is decorative and not cropped.

problems.title: OM1
problems.statement:
(OM1) Mark any 5 (five) of the following stars on the map by putting a circle (O) around the appropriate star and writing its code next to it. If you mark more than 5 stars, only the first 5 in serial order will be considered. **[20]**

| Code | Name | Bayer Name | Code | Name | Bayer Name |
|------|------|------------|------|------|------------|
| S1 | Caph | β Cas | S5 | Sheliak | β Lyr |
| S2 | Asellus Australis | δ Cnc | S6 | Albireo | β Cyg |
| S3 | Acrux | α Cru | S7 | Rasalhague | α Oph |
| S4 | Alphard | α Hya | S8 | Kaus Australis | ε Sgr |

solution.incompleteReason: No solutions document is present in the archive for this paper.

problems.title: OM2
problems.statement:
(OM2) Mark location of any 3 (three) of the following galaxies on the map by putting a ‘+’ sign at appropriate place in the map and writing its code next to it. If you mark more than 3 galaxies, only the first 3 in serial order will be considered. **[15]**

| Code | Name | M number | Code | Name | M number |
|------|------|----------|------|------|----------|
| G1 | Triangulum Galaxy | M 33 | G4 | Virgo A | M 87 |
| G2 | Whirlpool Galaxy | M 51 | G5 | Sombrero Galaxy | M 104 |
| G3 | Southern Pinwheel Galaxy | M 83 | | | |
